capabilities: Run local shells in split panes
Hand off note context to AI CLIs
Open file references from terminal output
extras: Desktop-only because it uses a native Rust PTY backend. No telemetry or analytics. Downloads the matching native PTY binary from GitHub Releases on demand; offline mode disables downloads and update checks. Uses local WebSocket connections for terminal transport and the IDE bridge, plus a local-only dsh-TUI selection bridge on 127.0.0.1. UI localized in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian. Listed in the official Community Plugins directory; BRAT can track early tagged builds.
motivation: Built for people who already live in Obsidian and do real work in a terminal, wanting more than a plain terminal pane but a workflow-oriented environment aligned with vault and editor context.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, and AI CLI sessions started outside it cannot access the active note, vault, or editor selection.
